about: Clifton W. Albright Jr. is a partner in the Los Angeles, California, office of Albright, Yee & Schmit, APC, where he plays an integral role on the firm’s labor, employment and business litigation team. With a practice spanning general and complex business disputes as well as labor and employment matters, he has guided clients through every phase of litigation from initial complaint through jury trial.

Mr. Albright regularly conducts sensitive workplace investigations into allegations of discrimination, harassment, retaliation and wage-and-hour violations, helping employers navigate potential liabilities and fostering compliance with California law. He earned his bachelor's degree in business management from the University of Arizona before obtaining his Juris Doctor from Loyola Law School, Los Angeles.

While in law school, Mr. Albright distinguished himself as a member of the nationally ranked Byrne Trial Advocacy Team, which is currently placed fourth in the nation. He also gained invaluable judicial insight as a law clerk to the Honorable Carol Rose of the Los Angeles County Superior Court.

Throughout his career, Mr. Albright’s litigation acumen and commitment to client service have been recognized extensively. He has been selected as an "Ones to Watch” honoree by Best Lawyers for 2024–2026. In 2024, Top 100 Lawyers named him Attorney of the Year in California, and the Los Angeles Times B2B spotlighted him as a “Legal Visionary.” The Los Angeles Business Journal has also included him among its “Leaders of Influence” in several categories: litigators and trial attorneys (2025), minority attorneys (2024 and 2026), and labor & employment attorneys (2023).
Mr. Albright combines his courtroom prowess, business background and profound understanding of employment law to deliver strategic, results-driven counseling to his clients.
